changes: Fixed closing the loop on elliptical orbit line drawing.
Added tooltips back for autopilot control.
Added separate fontsize setting for tooltips.
Fixed handling of start Ta and end Ta for patch rendering on elliptical orbits correctly.
Fixed impact handling on ground tracker.
Fixed not closing and closing the rendering loop on orbits that actually have an end Ta, or not (eg: patched conics patches).
Fixed deconfliction of hovering over points on orbit lines.
Added Support for sounds fading in and out on start and stop playback.
Added 3d sounds are now filtered based on atmospheric pressure.
Added ChannelWrapper class for handling Fmod channel behaviour.
Added Sound pitch of 3d sounds is now effected by sim speed. Sounds do not play if sim-speed is greater than 10x
Added new Default engine and thruster sounds that are full spectrum, the sounds will now be filtered based on atmospheric pressure.
Added Static function on PhysicalAtmosphereReference that returns the atmospheric pressure in atmospheres at the passed in camera position.
Merged Orbit.DrawLines methods into one.
Fixed relative patch drawing that was broken by the recent -PI to PI orbit refactor.
Removed Tooltip font size setting, didn't make sense to have to separate to the font size. Now this font size is derrived from the font in general, and can be used for other things.
Cleanup of Ground Tracking Window. Moved drawing functions outside of Orbit, to keep it clean.
Added impact indicator to Ground Tracking, including time.
Added Atmospheric Flight indication by coloring the track red to the Ground Tracking.
Added Landed state handling to Ground Tracking. Vehicles that report their physics situation as "landed" will not draw impact details and will color themselves a light blue.
Changed various Ground Tracking visual aspects to improve readability, including adding single pixel black outlines to many elements to make them visually distinct. Repositioned many widgets.
Changed Terminator and Subsolar point indicators to be off by default on ground tracking, as enough visual information will be on the map by default and these are more niche uses.
Added first pass over lighting (Only affects vessels for now)
Added tenp point lights to thrusters for testing purposes
Fixed debug names for shadows.
Fixed celestial mesh collection null check in PlanetShadows
Changed patched conic creation from calc data to be single-phase rather than two-phase initialization.
Removed redundant PrimaryBody field on PatchedConic and forward to the underlying Orbit.
Initialze PatchedConic.StartTrueAnomaly in the constructor instead of outside.
Forward GetTrueAnomaly(MeanAnomly) to GetTrueAnomaly(EccentricAnomaly) rather than having a parallel implementation.
Added some inlining hints.
Some more cleanup after removal of PrimaryBody field on PatchedConics.
Removed redundant DebugName field from Astronomical. Use Id field instead.
Changed inheriting classes from Astronomical to use C#9+ covariant types to make parent input not nullable.
A bunch more cleanup now that Parent cannot be null on anything other than an Astronomical / StellarBody.
Fixed Orbit line points not going all the way out to escape on hyperbolic patches.
Changed highlighting of orbit lines to use interpolated points to create a smoother selection feel.
Fixed hover checks breaking orbit highlighting.
Fixed easily double adding maneuvers when clicking.
Fixed being able to add maneuvers to parent astronomicals.
Fixed adding maneuvers out of order to maneuver plans.
Fixed deselecting maneuvers via 'cancel' keybind.
Added ability to close maneuver UI elements to deselect the node.
Added ability to deselect maneuver node via left clicking on it again.
Fixed maneuver node dragging over Ap and Pe boundaries after the -PI to PI refactor last week.
Fixed an ImGui error when vehicles were made with an empty Id string.

Added a basic handling of surface following to FlyController, taken from OrbitController. Longer term we probably want to migrate much more of the behavior through. Currently it is now hardcoded so when you are in free camera, and "following" a planetary body, your camera will always rotate with the surface of the planet. The current usecase of this camera and controller mode is for videos and screenshots.
Added clearer default free camera handling, with the default value now set to 1000 m/s rather than 1 AU/s
Moved VehicleTemplate to inherit from AstronomicalTemplate, as this now models the Vehicle class relationship.
Added first pass of architectural work for GLFW joystick support. Currently, detecting joystick connect/disconnect and the first pass of generic serialization.
Added a very basic double click follow system.
Change ground track lines to be purely alpha based and not darkening, for better visual effect.
Add per-cloud type multipleScatteringBrightness, prevent thinner clouds from being overblown in brightness due to how multiple scattering is approximated
Add density-over-height curve to cloud types, in addition to existing shape curve

Add mars dust storms configs, having both a dense "front" and more diffuse sections. Storm fronts are currently exaggerated in scale and in distribution for showing off. Can be toned down to be more realistic in the future
Add color and lambertian settings for 2d clouds for better 2d cloud terminators
Add option to use separate 2d cloud texture from volumetrics texture
Fix small mistake in cloud bound intersections resulting in some raymarching steps being wasted
Tweak earth cloud settings to reduce noise when craft is flying through clouds
Tweak earth clouds transition to 2d texture to happen at a higher altitude
Fix vulkan validation error in cloud shader due to mismatch between imageview format and shader
Improve cloud early exit threshold to not cause a noticeable edge discontinuity on thing dust storms
Fix indexOutOfBounds exception in cubicHermiteSpline in some cases

Added procedural terrain modifiers. These modifiers can be applied globally or regionally (per-biome). This may be extended to allow a separate biome map to be defined specifically for these modifiers.
Added the WebGL noise library and separated commonly used functions into a Common.glsl.
Added deserialization of procedural modifiers from the system XML. This is polymorphic, allowing for modifiers to be read into the correct derived type based on the "noiseType" XML attribute.
Changed the bindings for the planet height and normal passes with the addition of the terrain modifier storage buffer.
Added Hybrid Multifractal noise type
Added GUI editing for procedural terrain modifiers
Rescaled terrain shader debug visual for the world normals from [-1, 1] to [0, 1]
Removed debug logging from TerrainReference
Added a (commented-out) extra CubeMesh to the planet meshes. I'd like to enable it but only after iterating on the existing mesh collection.
Fixed missing orbit line gap on elliptical orbits after -PI to PI changes.
Fixed drawing of Ap and Pe UI markers after -PI to PI changes.
Fixed PatchedConics.TrueAnomalyInPatch method to account for -PI to PI range.
Fixed incorrect setting of StartTrueAnomaly and EndTrueAnomaly in PatchedConic constructor.

Added MultiSound Data type. Allows for playback of a selection of sounds with a single play/stop command. You can specify n number of start-sounds, sounds and stop-sound. Use Selection rule to decide which sound in the list to play [Sequential, Random, Shuffle].
Added a Sound Data can now have a random pitch Multiplier and volume Multiplier specified i.e. Pitch Min="0.9" Max="1.2".
Switched maneuver nodes to be centered around a sphere.

Compressed the terrain textures. Normals are BC5 ATI2 and diffuse/roughMetalAO maps are BC1 unless the diffuse maps have alpha in which case they are BC3 DXT5. Displacement and height maps are not yet compressed.
Removed some old keybinds that weren't using the correct input system.
Separated concepts of following and controlling to give more camera flexibility.
Added first pass on BC decoding functions to help with future work to allow rescaling of textures.
Add *.DDS file format to be tracked using LFS.
Removed EccentricAnomaly from OrbitPointCce - instead we can just use TimeSincePe.
Fixed opacity of orbit lines to correctly fade from start to end of patches and/or from current celestial/vehicle position around to end of patch or around the full orbit if elliptical.
Added back automatically taking control of a vessel when the camera switches to it.
Fixed invalid maneuver time when patch start and maneuver are before Pe. This is yet another issue from the -PI to PI orbit change.
Added key assignments for transfer plan and flight plan.
Fixed dragging of maneuver nodes around orbits when crossing the orbital period.
Improved on position accuracy of interpolated orbital point.
Fixed hovering falling off the start or end of some orbit lines.
Fix for swapchains with more than two image buffers (triple buffering or higher)
Setup multi-buffering storage for lights.
Added dynamic descriptors for light system.
Added FramePackedVkBuffer.
Added spot light debug gizmos inc. menu bar toggle.
Reintegrated flight computer automatic burns. This required doing some terrible things to ManeuverPlan, will need to think about this more.
Moved burn time calculator logic from the UI into the flight computer.
Changed FlightComputer and some subordinate structs into classes since they want to be modified in-place and it was extremely easy to accidentally create and modify a local copy.

Add background occlusion to plumes and approximate order-independent-transparency for plume-to-plume occlusion. Allow thick plumes to occlude each other and the background while avoiding sorting. OIT to be tweaked as the quality varies based on distance and also slightly affects purely emissive plumes
Fixed trench on moon
Fixed bug where you were unable to create a maneuver if the vehicle was off rails.
Renamed some methods to make it more obvious about what time since Pe we are talking about. Negative/Positive time or Next/since - future time.
Fixed bug where maneuver time would get offset by orbit time differences when vehicle is maneuvering.
Automatically go into burn pointing mode when auto-burn is armed and burn ignition time is near.
Compute a conservative 180-degree flip time so we know when to activate burn pointing.
Removed all hand-specified sphere of influence values from the XML in favor of automatically computed values.
Fixed erroneous denominator in SOI calc function.
Set StellarBody SOI to infinity.
Further progress with secondary windows/viewports
Secondary viewports now also support Vehicle, Line and Maneuver rendering
Added extra available cameras/viewports to make sure everything works with more than just 2 windows
Fixed where initial orbit patch was computing wrong Starting True Anomaly.
Partially fixed current position insertion into orbit line drawing.
Fixed one extra orbit point being drawn past patch end.
Fixed vehicle current orbit actually being drawn twice, which was causing Pe and Ap markers being drawn sometimes outside the patch start and end times.

Fixed bug in TrueAnomalyInPatch missing one edge case. Causing issue with not being able to create maneuver on some patches when you should be able to, as well as erroneous orbit line opacity in same edge cases.
Fixed issue where current vehicle position point insertion into orbit line rendering not always being correct where patch start and end wrapped around Periapsis.
Removing unnecessary config files
Don't create thread workers if the sim step is zero.
Remove now-redundant sim step checks from the update task.
Moved orbit point mouse hover logic to after the camera is updated. This was causing weird drawing artifacts at higher simulation speeds.
Fixed the inclination of the Moon, which erroneously had its Earth inclination set to the value of its ecliptic inclination.
Removed ManeuverController class. No longer used or required.
Fixed potential index out of range exception on ManueverPlan.
Started preliminary work for a 'map mode'. GPU shader for the grid is done (barring design tweaks and/or bugs) and can be toggled on and off via a debug flag in the debug menu on the main bar.
Fixed orbit lines outside the projection far plane not setting their depth after avoiding depth culling causing inaccurate fragments depending on draw order.
Fixed issue where creating a maneuver on future patches was incorrectly setting the parent/patch, and crazy badness ensued.
Removed unnecessary variable passing into ManeuveurPlan.AddManeuver().
Changed the maneuver node clipping workaround to use a solution in the shader to make position more consistent and less hacky.
Fixed not handling NaNs and returning null on GetNextTimeToRadius when there is NO possibility of it happening (hyperbolic orbits).
Fixed divide by zero edge case with planet billboard
Fixed another divide-by-zero edge case in planet renderer
Fixed handling of invalid starting orbit (cannot be hyperbolic) in the transfer planner UI.
Renamed Maneuver to Burn everywhere in the code base. You can thank me later Dean.
Fixed missing joining orbit point at Ap when drawing lines for celestials.
Added 'Mountain Erosion' procedural noise type.
Added Simplex Noise library which includes derivative noise.
Added erosion functions that could potentially be used in the future to apply erosion to other heightfields we have derivatives for.
Added procedural sand dunes to Mars.
Added some procedural mountains to Mars to test out the mountain erosion.
Moved constant F4 from common.glsl to each noise type and undef it at the end, as the constant is also used across the new Simplex noise library.
Darkened the Mars cliffs albedo texture to better match the darker base terrain texture.

Added float curve support for terrain procedural modifiers. Curves are stored in a single LUT per planet with U=curve index, V=key and the sample result corresponding to the curve value for the specified curve index and key.
Added LUT generation helper functions to CubicHermiteSpline.
Added terrain slope debug visualisation.
Added erosion falloff strength parameter to the mountain erosion modifier.

Refactored the  terrain modifier code. There's now a ProceduralModifiersRenderData class responsible for organising all procedural modifiers and their float curve LUTs, and the modifier setup is no longer done in the XML references.
Added a new default Linear Clamp sampler for sampling modifier LUTs.
Added modifier float curve editing to the terrain editor GUI.
Changed the copy pass for fake transparent UI to respect passed in alpha rather than hardcoding it.
Fixed Orbit.GetRemainingTimeTo (True Anomaly) for parabolic orbits.
Fixed Orbit.GetMeanAnomaly (Eccentric Anomaly) for parabolic orbits.
Fixed Orbit.GetEccentricAnomaly (True Anomaly) for parabolic orbits.
Added GameSetting to Interface to turn on and off orbit lines in all cameras or only in Map camera (by default).
Added logic to only show orbit lines based on the game setting and camera mode.
Fixed mountain erosion terrain modifier creating sharp peaks where the noise gradient becomes aligned with the planet up vector
Adjusted Mars' sand dunes to account for the mountain erosion changes
Fixed missing normalize in the planet mesh pass
Fixed Luna's minor perturbations terrain modifier using the wrong frequency.
Fixed display of celestial info for celestials. That I broke'd when I removed the vehicle class inheritence. Though shalt call base class methods.
Added debug option to show SOI of any celestial via celestialinfo window.
Added ability to display celestialinfo for stars. 'Cause maybe someone wants to know info like that.
Remove .DS_Store files and ignore

Implement ocean surface using configurable gerstner waves. Use sky reflections, ambient and specular for shading. Use water fresnel term. Use screen derivatives to filter out small waves in the distance. Use depth buffer for transparency. Disable ocean by default in game settings as its still wip.
Disable old atmosphere shader method applying sun transmittance to all objects
Reorganize folders: Move atmosphere folder to KSA/Rendering and splines folder out of KSA/Rendering/VolumetricExhaust
Better weighting of purely emissive plumes in OIT
Small optimizations in volumetric exhaust shader for absorbing plumes
Small improvement in volumetric exhaust average position calculation and OIT weighting
Expose upscaling settings for volumetric exhausts to be able to tweak the quality/performance
Pass pushConstant shaderStageFlags to computePipelineWrapper on creation

Changed orbit line rendering and UI to only display based on distance rules which means they turn on and off as appropriate based on distance from camera, what object the camera is following, including not drawing when too far away from the camera. Player can still filter orbits on and off via the view menu - but this now ONLY applies to map camera mode.
Multi-window support for the Menu Bar for easier navigation from that window

Added ability for celestial worker tasks to run flight plan and burn plan updates even when the simulation is paused. This allows the player to create/change burns and patches with the simulation paused and see the instant results.
Updated to Brutal Framework v25.7.0.1
Fixed BOM problem in some shader files
Fixed crash due to missing key in UTF8StringPool
Fixed missing import needed for new Brutal Framework
Minor fix for secondary windows not being detachable from the main window
Added ability to warp to next event. Next event being: Next Pe, Next Ap, Next Bur or Next SOI change.
Added button to warp to next event.
Fixed a whole bunch of UI rendering to draw to the passed in viewport to allow drawing in different viewports.
Fixed filtering of patch UI rendering so that it isn't filtered out too early as you zoom the camera around.
Changed backwards loops to forwards, as we don't need to go backwards anymore.
Changes to allow ceelstial info UI windows and Flight Plan UI windows to be dragged out of the main viewport.
Case-sensitive asset fixes for linux
Menubar input fix for secondary windows
Changed the flightplan UI window to have a scrollbar and not keep resizing.
Changed the flightplan UI to only show encounter info when there actually is an encounter on each patch.
Fixed some over-zealous patch, burn and UI drawing filtering so that they appear when it makes a bit more sense.
Fixed the handling of burns on potentially invalid patches, but still allow them, until they are no longer valid/deleted by the user. This allows more flexibility when planning burns.
